utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday, sixth of July. Can you hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: We can hear you. Bit of an echo, but that might be this tin box.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Before we start—did anyone see the football last night?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Enough of it. Not sure I'd call that defending.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly! Just stood there watching it go past. Could've put a traffic cone in.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, football analysis concluded. Probably more successfully than the match.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And the heating in the portakabin—it's July and I was roasting in here. Not a maintenance request, just having a moan.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: A very seasonal moan.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, well, we've got winter outside and August under the desk.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Lovely. Let's separate what's finished from what we're actually agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I've already swapped the filter on the chiller on three yesterday. That's done, not another filter job.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, finished work. I've got that separate from the outstanding sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I tested the cold unit yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Good. No repeat test being added here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Also, already swapped the filter on the hot bearing yesterday. That one's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're on updates, I heard a slight rattle from the alarm box, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same sort of observation here—heard a slight rattle from the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, observations only, neither of those is a new job out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, my blocker hasn't moved. I can't get to the front end of one until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There isn't a window agreed. So that's still blocked, not a promise for today.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Don't want it sounding as if I'm in there already.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. What can we actually commit to, then?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I'll do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances by end of day. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Pre-use being the important bit there—not running them first and catching up with the checks afterwards.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Absolutely. Before use. End of day is the outer deadline for getting the checks done.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks, Mide. Urgent, by end of day, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'll chase the purchase order for the GT2 Number 2 Bearing by the 28th. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's the PO chase, rather than promising the bearing will be here by the 28th?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, the chase. I'm not giving you a delivery date I haven't got.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Fine, Marc. Purchase order chase by the 28th; important, not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Good. Those two things get muddled surprisingly easily.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll write up the near miss at the pop valve. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: The write-up, yeah. We're not describing a live emergency here.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly, the near-miss account. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace Liu. Agreed, no deadline being added to that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, caught half of that over the fan. Got it now—the write-up.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll book a contractor to look at the HRSG this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Pri, that's making the booking this morning, not the contractor turning up this morning?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes, booking this morning. I'm not promising an attendance time.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, that makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Marc, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the chiller on three? The due phrase on this is on the 3rd, and that one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that sign-off. Don't put it against me.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just to be clear, on the 3rd is already past. We're not quietly moving it to a future date?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Correct. It was due on the 3rd; it's outstanding. Saz, can you take the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the chiller on three instead? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take it. Due on the 3rd, still outstanding, and I'll do the sign-off straight away.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And the filter being finished doesn't stand in for the isolation sign-off. Separate things.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, absolutely. I wasn't claiming the filter swap closed that out.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Good. Saz has the sign-off, not Marc. Safety-critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Also, boss, can you do a site visit at Northfield Substation with the contractor? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the site visit at Northfield Substation with the contractor.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Normal priority, and there's no visit date agreed in this discussion.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's right. No extra date attached.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Haley, can you recalibrate the sensors on the little water valve on two? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the little water valve on two. Normal priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The sensor calibration, not changing the valve itself.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, just the sensors. No valve replacement sneaking onto the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the new line tomorrow morning. Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Both parts—the permit to work and the isolation?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Both, yes. I'll sort them tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Cheers, boss. Fairly important, tomorrow morning, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Last one: safety Grace, can you grease and check the bearings on the air compressor Monday? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll grease and check the bearings on the air compressor Monday. No rush, understood.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Monday being today, just so that doesn't end up looking like next week's work.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes, today, Monday. Still no rush; that's the priority we've agreed.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine by me. Grease and bearing check, both covered.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nothing else from me. Mine were the finished test and the observation, not extra jobs.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the access blocker stays a blocker. Apart from that, all clear.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Thanks, everyone. And please spare us the football replay in the next call.
